title: Multiplexer: Steering 2^n Inputs with n Select Lines
quickIdea: A multiplexer is a data selector: n select lines pick one of 2^n data inputs and steer it to the single output. Written as an equation it is a sum of minterms of the select variables, each weighted by its data input.
remember: 2^n data inputs, n select lines, 1 output. 'A multiplexer with a 4-bit data select input' therefore has 16 data inputs.
The select code of an input is its index in binary: on an 8-to-1 multiplexer, input I6 is selected by S2S1S0 = 110.
A multiplexer is Shannon's expansion in hardware: F = x'F(x=0) + xF(x=1) is exactly a 2-to-1 multiplexer with x on the select line and the two cofactors on the data inputs.
Because the data inputs can be constants, variables or complements, a multiplexer is a universal logic block - any function can be built on one (next card).
A demultiplexer is the inverse: one input steered to one of 2^n outputs by n select lines, and it is the same circuit as a decoder with the data line acting as the enable.

example.prompt: Write the output of a 4-to-1 multiplexer whose select lines are S1 = P and S0 = Q and whose data inputs are I0 = 0, I1 = 1, I2 = R and I3 = NOT R.
example.work: Substitute into Y = S1'S0'I0 + S1'S0I1 + S1S0'I2 + S1S0I3: the first product vanishes because I0 = 0, the second is P'Q, the third is PQ'R and the fourth is PQR'.
example.answer: F = P'Q + PQ'R + PQR'. This is the expression GATE CSE 2014 Set 1 Q.45 asks you to minimise, and its minimal form is P'Q + QR' + PQ'R.

gateAngle: Multiplexer questions in the papers are of two kinds: sizing (how many select lines, how many blocks) and function realisation (which data inputs implement the function). Both start from the sum-of-minterms equation, so writing that equation first is the method that never fails.

variations.label: CONCEPTUAL PRACTICE QUESTION
variations.question: How many select lines does a 32-to-1 multiplexer need, and how many data inputs does a multiplexer with 6 select lines have?
variations.answer: Five select lines, since 2^5 = 32; and 2^6 = 64 data inputs.
variations.why: The select count is the base-2 logarithm of the data count. The relation is exact only for a power of two, which is why multiplexer sizes are always 2^n.

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: Write the output equation of an 8-to-1 multiplexer with select lines S2S1S0 = A B C and data inputs I0 to I7.
variations.answer: Y = A'B'C'I0 + A'B'CI1 + A'BC'I2 + A'BCI3 + AB'C'I4 + AB'CI5 + ABC'I6 + ABCI7.
variations.why: Each select code selects exactly one input, so the output is the sum of the eight select minterms each multiplied by its data input. Setting all eight data inputs to 1 gives Y = 1; setting them to the function's minterm values gives the function.

variations.label: PREDICTED VARIATION
variations.question: A 2-to-1 multiplexer has its output fed back into input I0, and I1 is a data line. What does the circuit do?
variations.answer: It holds its previous output while S = 0 and takes the new data when S = 1 - it is a latch, not a combinational circuit.
variations.why: The feedback path makes the output depend on its own earlier value, which is the definition of stored state. The same gates without the feedback wire are combinational.

trap.what: Confusing the number of data inputs with the number of select lines, or reversing the select order so that I0 and I3 swap.
trap.why: The phrase 'n-bit select' gives n select lines and 2^n data inputs; the phrase 'n-to-1' gives n data inputs and log2(n) select lines. And S1 is the more significant select bit, so it multiplies the upper half of the data inputs, not the lower.
trap.counterexample: On a 4-to-1 multiplexer with select 10, the selected input is I2, not I1: S1 = 1 selects the bottom half and S0 = 0 takes the first entry of that half.

check.question: A 4-to-1 multiplexer has S1S0 = 10 and I2 = 0. What is the output, whatever the other data inputs are?
check.answer: 0, because the select code 10 selects I2 and only I2.
check.explanation: The four product terms of the output equation are mutually exclusive - exactly one select code is true at a time - so only the term carrying I2 can be 1. With I2 = 0 the output is 0.
